_comment: Copy to pool.config.json and edit. The real config is gitignored.
_fee: Taken off the BLOCK REWARD, never off a miner's accrued balance. 50 PCN found -> 49 into PPLNS, 1 to the pool. Converted to basis points once, at config load, so nothing downstream of it touches a float. Set feeBasisPoints directly if you want a fraction of a percent.
_allowlist: FLEET-ONLY IS ENFORCED HERE. Empty array = open to anyone. During the first week list only the fleet's payout addresses, so a stranger who finds the port is refused instead of silently accruing a balance nobody planned to pay.
_db: The share ledger. Every accepted share is fsynced here BEFORE the miner is told OK. Back it up like a wallet: it is the only record of who is owed what. Reconcile with `node payouts.mjs`.
_pplns: windowMultiplier sets N as a multiple of the work in ONE block, measured in hashes rather than shares -- so it stays correct through vardiff and through LWMA retargeting every block. 2 is the design's 'about twice an average round'. maturity is coinbase maturity in blocks and must match consensus (100); a block's payouts show as PENDING until then.
_vardiff: Every share costs the pool ~21.7 ms of CPU, so share rate is a budget, not a comfort setting. targetSeconds is the interval each miner is held near.
